name: WANTED: Baron Longshore
objectiveText: Bring the head of Baron Longshore to Gazlowe in Ratchet. Baron Longshore's Head  ( 1 )

comments.body: He can be in front of any of the three camps running along the shore.  He respawns within 2 minutes once he's killed so keep an eye out for him.

He must randomly spawn at the different tents in the area so if you don't see him straight away make sure you check all the tents in teh area..for me he was at the far south pair of tents.

For those who need co-ordinates it was 63,49 on this occasion.
Solod as a level 13 mage with only minor difficulty.  Might be hard as other classes until level 14 or 15.  He was located at 64, 47 near a tent.  Human wearing a red long-coat.
Quest giver is a poster, located to the left of the bank NPCs. Has no exclamation point but will give the quest when you interact with it.
RESPAWN AT 64,47 !

As of 06/06/2019, Wowhead incorrectly labels this quest as Horde: It is in fact doable by both Alliance and Horde.

OK, so here is the deal.  This mob is always up somewhere, but he has three different spawn points.  He will either be in front of the tents at roughly 64,47 or he will be in front of one of the two sets of tents further south from there.  He does *not* spawn in front of the two sets of tents furthest north (those two closest to Ratchet).  Therefore, once he dies, he immediately respawns at one of the other two possible locations.  Just go through these three locations and you should find him.  He stands out due to his red coat.
The right loc is /mntloc 63,48

Easily soloable after level 17 or so.  I've found Baron Longshore in a bunch of different places, but generally he's at the last camp before Northwatch Hold.  Easy to spot - red jacket, black hat.  Almost exactly like Captain Morgan, as another poster mentioned.
got him at 62, 50

One of the easiest quest mobs there is, just solo'd as a 13 mage. Move round the back of the tent, and nuke the cannoneer. Pull him with a fireball, nova him and the add, sheem the add and then spam your fastest spell (to make up for resits), preferably frostbolt  (faster + slow). Kite him back a bit, running sideways to through in fireblast, and then finish him with wand. I was oom and low on health at this point so I ran after looting ^^
